_comment: CONTROL for stuffy_nomads_act_doll_26: the Nomads replaced by a vanilla 1/1 of ours (no shields). The Act
reflects only 13 and the Doll pings once a turn after: no win by turn 6, so the shields make that kill.
Nomads en-Kor shields, design step 8 (docs/design/damage-reflection-pipeline.md 4.2 / 10). Nomads en-Kor +
Stuffy Doll (chosen the opponent) + four opponent Spirits = 6 creatures, so Blasphemous Act costs {2}{R}.
The Act deals 13 to each creature; Nomads' free {0} shields (activated in response to our own sweeper --
the rider, searched on the damage pipeline's pin stream) move all 13 of ITS damage onto the Doll. The
Doll's own 13 and the redirected 13 are ONE damage event (one reflection trigger for the total, rulings),
so the Doll reflects 26 -- exactly the opponent's life. The plain Act reflects only 13, and pinging once
a turn afterwards cannot reach 26 by turn 6.
